'''Dar'Khan Drathir''' (sometimes spelled as "'''Dar'khan'''")<ref name="A Good Day" /> is a traitor to the [[Quel'Thalas (kingdom)|Kingdom of Quel'Thalas]] and is now the current ruler of Quel'Thalas, lording over the [[Scourge]] within the [[Eversong Wastes]] from [[Silvermoon City]] to the [[Blackened Woods]].<ref name="A Good Day" />
